A LITTLE PRACTICE GOES A LONG WAY

Make your first ollie.

Easy Demo: tap OLLIE (or Space). The board rolls, pops and catches for you. You choose when to jump.

  1. ROLLThe board rolls for you. Slide the left pad to adjust your speed.
  2. LOAD & POPHold the right pad to load the tail. Release when the bar fills to pop higher. A quick upward flick adds a little extra pop.
  3. LEVEL, FLIP & CATCHDrag on the left pad to level the deck. For a kickflip, pop first, then flick the left/front pad quickly up and diagonally sideways. Press the right/rear pad in the air to catch it.
  4. LANDBring the wheels down level with the surface. Clean ollies build your score and line multiplier.

Keyboard: ← / → speed · ↑ / ↓ tilt · Space load, pop & catch · P pause · R restart.

Kickflips are available in DROP IN. Easy Demo stays ollie-only. Your best score is saved on this browser.
